about.title: Built for
about.lead: Wieland AI is a modern AI with real-time responses, visual understanding and intelligence. Built for a first-class online experience.
about.whyLead: Other AIs are often either too simple and unreliable or so complex that setup and debugging consume more time than real productivity.
about.whyBody: Wieland AI combines this flow in one fast interface with reliable outputs, smart models and a familiar UX.

core.title: Ready-to-go experiences
core.text: From first prompt to finished workflow, every interaction is designed to feel smooth, high quality and instantly responsive.

core.title: Transparency & control
core.text: Transparency that is enjoyable: you see what happens and decide how your AI flow works.

core.title: True multimodality
core.text: Full understanding of text and images in a single run.

core.title: Scale without outages
core.text: Our production-grade deployments keep your AI assistant stable even under peak load.

changelogs.lead: All versions, fixes and features - documented chronologically.

entries.title: AI, Extension & UX Expansion
changes: Extension improvements with better page context handling
Improved website search in the extension
AI memory improvements (auto save, relevance retrieval, multilingual support)
Improved internet access and intent routing
Added clarification popup modal in web and extension (options + free text)
Improved clarification flow and cleaner streamed output
Cinematic 404 page redesign with updated 3D scene

entries.title: Browser Extension & Web Access
changes: Added Wieland AI Browser Extension (side panel chat inside the browser)
Added internet access mode for the model with source links and offline fallback
Added browser extension language support (de/en/it) with automatic website language sync
Added full favicon package and web manifest for broader browser and device support
Download page now delivers the browser extension as a ZIP
Bug fixes and UI cleanup across chat and extension menus

entries.title: Language UPDATEEEE (i18n)
changes: Connected header language switch to real route + locale changes
Expanded translations for pages, modals and dashboard
Fixed language-switch regressions (Home welcome live update, About stats cards stay visible)

entries.title: Backend & Auth Update
changes: Login cookie now depends on consent
